item.description:
## New Features
- See the Fast portion of tool and model usage bars in both Tokens and Cost. - Read Antigravity desktop usage live from local conversations, including titles, and see completed turns from Antigravity desktop and CLI in Speed.
## Fixes
- Prevent duplicate or missing Antigravity usage when upgrading from the old cache to the local conversation database. - Correct overcounted input tokens in Antigravity CLI conversations. - Keep existing estimates when only hourly placement changes, and leave Antigravity usage without a request timestamp out of the hourly bars.
